title: External reproduction attempt (and optional adjudication)
description: One committed transcription of a public reproduction report: the attempt fields at top level plus an optional adjudication block that applies the verification procedure (docs/reproduction-policy.md). Shape only — the cross-field gates (an adjudication verdict of externally_reproduced requires a byte_identical outcome, a non-author reproducer, and all four independence criteria judged met; an attempt may not judge any criterion itself) are enforced in essun.evidence.reproductions, where the attempt is available for cross-checking. The label therefore cannot be asserted by shape-valid content alone.

reported.description: Date the public report was posted (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

report_url.description: Public, auditable pointer to the report (issue comment, PR, equivalent).

reproducer.description: Public identity of who ran it, as declared in the report.

reproduced_at_commit.description: Full commit hash of the public tree the reproducer used.

outcome.description: byte_identical: every named run id regenerated byte-for-byte. diverged: at least one did not (enters the counterexample path). incomplete: the walk stopped before an outcome.

divergence_notes.description: Required non-null exactly when outcome is not byte_identical.

reproduced_run_ids.description: The stored run ids the attempt re-executed.

independence.description: Attempt-time independence is ALWAYS null (unknown): a report about oneself is not a judgment about oneself. Judgments live only in the adjudication block.

basis.description: What was checked and how, with pointers an auditor can re-derive.
